description: Adventure-owned SQL normal-run lifecycle and individual settlement, plus retained batch crawl execution.

transaction_boundaries.note: StartStage performs ordinary access reads and delegates immediate crawl execution to ExecuteCrawl.
Production composition first serializes retained batch admission through sorted character locks and owned-activity checks, then delegates batch execution and ambient settlement.

lock_sequence.note: Lock participating characters ascending by ID and apply rewards/vitality
Lock inventories, consume master keys, and deliver Floor 11 treasure drops
Conditional overflow delivery when inventory is full
Persist resolved adventure history record for each participant in the same transaction

transaction_boundaries.note: Wraps post-battle reward/item settlement and adventure history persistence in a single RunInTx boundary; PostAdventureHook executes after commit.

lock_sequence.note: Admission identity also serializes the one-way Party handoff and waiting roster writers.

transaction_boundaries.note: Starts before ambient character locks; callback owns bounded state, assets, history and receipts. Reentrant only for the same already-locked run.

lock_sequence.note: Check actor-owned immutable receipt before new-command preconditions.
Complete active roster sorted by character ID; roster/leader order remains separate.

lock_sequence.mode: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE (ExecuteRunAction, economy runner, PostBattleSettler)
lock_sequence.note: Combat prelocks party inventories in ascending character order before the asset session. Settlement reuses those locks and applies concrete consumption and chest delivery. Equipment reads are ordinary reads.
Requester depot for combat assets and conditional overflow delivery.
Recipient history, disposition and immutable command result commit with state and assets.

transaction_boundaries.note: One bounded SQL transaction via WithRunForUpdate. The production RunCombat (NewRunCombat) runs the player step and at most one NPC response under this authority and can use Adventure-owned travel mutations. No automatic combat fallback. Cleanup recovery projects a stored absolute timer deadline before releasing pending ownership.

lock_sequence.note: Prelock all party inventories in character ID order before WithJobAssets. In a solo run WithJobAssets acquires the inventory lock.

transaction_boundaries.note: Runs inside Command after its run and sorted character locks. The configured economy runner saves tail growth and wallet changes on the same requester. Reads retained earnings without row locks and returns consumption and earnings for Command's settler. Travel and job-encounter ports mutate the locked run copy.

lock_sequence.note: Command already holds the full sorted roster; requester stays distinct from combat actor.
Requester wallet and held instance commit with Command state/receipt in the ambient SQL transaction.
Requester depot for job50 stored tools and job86 books; consumption, exchange and return save only when no selection error occurred.

transaction_boundaries.note: Requires Command's run authority. The economy runner saves the requester after applying tail growth and asset changes, with no independent commit. Helper request reads do not lock rows.

Mutation port for RunCombat under Command's existing transaction; no independent persistence, settlement or action-tail execution. Coordinate-only tools retain encounters; tool150 separates generated members and conditional old-enemy response before the caller saves the final run.
